stations.title: Idris
stations.say: Which cards and posters still wait?
stations.note: Asked in the address, after a ?.

stations.title: Old server
stations.text: Compares the whole address, ? and all.
stations.note: It has never heard of it.

captions: At Ashgrove Press, Idris asks which card and poster orders are still waiting.
The old server reads the question as part of the address and finds nothing.
You make the router read the query and the body once, carefully, in three tasks.
Now the orders handler gets Idris's question as an object and answers it.
Questions and new orders reach every handler ready to use, and rubbish gets a plain no.
